title: Wolt Ads for Merchants & Brands Growth - Wolt (Azerbaijan)

facts.fact: Wolt Ads are trusted by over 180,000 brands and merchants worldwide, according to Wolt's own page.
facts.quote: Wolt Ads are trusted by over 180,000 brands and merchants worldwide.

facts.fact: Wolt states that over 80% of Wolt Ads advertisers run ongoing campaigns.
facts.quote: Over 80% run ongoing campaigns — and keep coming back.

facts.fact: Wolt reports 50 million+ registered users buying on Wolt.
facts.quote: 50 million+ registered users buying on Wolt.

facts.fact: Wolt states its customers are spread across 30+ countries and 1,000+ cities.
Wolt states that over 60% of customers click on top positions.
facts.quote: Over 60% of customers click on top positions.

facts.fact: Wolt says merchants are only charged when customers place an order through Wolt Ads for restaurants and stores.
Wolt Ads offers a free trial, started through a sign-up form on the page.
